source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 18.2, block for block (PDF 86).

blocks.text: Yeh dikhane ke baad ke aik khasiyat ke alleles alag alag ho jate hain, Mendel ne dekha ke kya mukhtalif khasiyaton ke genes bhi aik doosre se azad ho kar (independently) alag hote hain. Us ne do khasiyatein ikatthi dekhin: beej ki shakal, jis mein gol (R) dominant aur jhurridar (r) recessive hai; aur beej ka rang, jis mein peela (Y) dominant aur hara (y) recessive hai. Us ne in khasiyaton ki khalis naslein (pure-breeding lines) banayin:

items: Dono dominant khasiyaton wale khalis paude: gol aur peele beej (RRYY).
Dono recessive khasiyaton wale khalis paude: jhurridar aur hare beej (rryy).

blocks.text: Us ne in khalis paudon ka cross kiya (RRYY × rryy). F1 ke sab beejon mein dono dominant khasiyatein thin (gol aur peele), aur un ka genotype RrYy tha, yaani heterozygous. Aise F1 paudon ko dihybrids kehte hain, kyunke woh dono genes ke liye heterozygous hain.

blocks.prompt: RrYy paude ko dihybrid kyun kehte hain?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke woh aik saath do genes ke liye heterozygous hai: beej ki shakal ke liye Rr aur beej ke rang ke liye Yy.

items: Mendel ne beej ki shakal (R/r) aur beej ka rang (Y/y) ikatthe dekhe.
RRYY × rryy se sab F1 gol aur peele, genotype RrYy: yeh dihybrids hain.
